=== chunk 0 | REST API reference | location - | 18 tokens ===
--- context ---
REST API reference
--- text ---
All endpoints live under `/v2` and require a bearer token.

=== chunk 1 | REST API reference > List widgets | location - | 25 tokens ===
--- context ---
REST API reference
List widgets
--- text ---
`GET /v2/widgets` returns every registered widget with its status and firmware version.

=== chunk 2 | REST API reference > Calibrate a widget | location - | 47 tokens ===
--- context ---
REST API reference
Calibrate a widget
--- text ---
`POST /v2/widgets/{serial}/calibrate` starts the calibration routine. Calibration takes about
ninety seconds and the widget reports **CALIBRATING** until it finishes.
